subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should Feishu startup continue waiting up to the current 30s bot-info probe before opening the account monitor, or should it mark identity degraded faster and recover in the background by default?
rationale: Changing this path affects Feishu auth/startup semantics and identity-dependent message routing, so automation should not pick the default without plugin-owner intent and live proof.

options.title: Keep conservative preflight
options.body: Keep the current 30s probe behavior until live Windows Feishu logs prove a narrower safe timing change.

options.title: Degrade faster by default
options.body: Shorten startup blocking and rely on background identity recovery, backed by tests and redacted live Feishu startup proof.

options.title: Document operator tuning
options.body: Leave defaults unchanged and document the existing timeout overrides as the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Keep conservative preflight
recommendation.body: Keep the current 30s probe behavior until live Windows Feishu logs prove a narrower safe timing change.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the startup behavior choice.
